name: updateSettings
description: Changes this plugin's settings, design and introduction screen, keeping every setting not given.

allowSubscriptions.description: Whether app users can follow a location to hear about its updates. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

timeFormat.description: How opening hours are written in the app. Leave it out to keep the current format.

defaultSorting.description: How the locations list is sorted at first. Distance needs nearest first sorting to be allowed. Leave it out to keep the current sorting.

hideSorting.description: Whether people are kept from changing the sorting. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

allowSortByReverseAlphabetical.description: Whether people can sort from Z to A. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

allowSortByNearest.description: Whether people can sort by how near locations are. Turning it off sorts the list alphabetically at first. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

allowSortByPriceHighToLow.description: Whether people can sort from the highest price. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

allowSortByPriceLowToHigh.description: Whether people can sort from the lowest price. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

allowSortByViews.description: Whether people can sort by views. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

allowSortByDate.description: Whether people can sort newest first. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

allowSortByRating.description: Whether people can sort by rating. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

allowFilterByArea.description: Whether people can narrow the list to an area of the map. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

hideOpeningHoursFilter.description: Whether the opening hours choice is hidden when people narrow the list. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

hidePriceFilter.description: Whether the price choice is hidden when people narrow the list. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

allowFilterByBookmarks.description: Whether people can narrow the list to their bookmarks. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

distanceUnit.description: The units distances are shown in. Leave it out to keep the current units.

enableInitialArea.description: Whether the map starts on the initial area. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

initialAreaLatitude.description: The latitude of the map's starting point, given with its longitude. Leave it out to keep the current point.

initialAreaLongitude.description: The longitude of the map's starting point, given with its latitude. Leave it out to keep the current point.

initialAreaAddress.description: The address shown for the map's starting point. Leave it out to keep the current one.

enableBookmarks.description: Whether people can bookmark locations and searches at all. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

allowBookmarkLocations.description: Whether people can bookmark a location. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

allowBookmarkSearch.description: Whether people can bookmark a search. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

enableOpenHours.description: Whether locations can have opening hours. Turning it off also stops app users from setting them. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

enablePriceRange.description: Whether locations can have a price range. Turning it off also stops app users from setting it. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

chargeForNewLocations.description: Who pays before adding a new location in the app; users with tags means the tags chosen in the control panel. Charging needs adding new locations to be allowed. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

paymentDetails.description: The payment terms shown to people who must pay before adding a location. Leave it out to keep the current text, or leave it empty to remove it.

listViewPosition.description: Where the locations list starts on the map screen. Leave it out to keep the current position.

listViewStyle.description: How each location looks in the list. Leave it out to keep the current style.

defaultMapType.description: The kind of map shown at first. Leave it out to keep the current type.

enableMapTerrainView.description: Whether the map shows terrain. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

hideQuickFilter.description: Whether the quick category buttons above the list are hidden. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

allowMapStyleSelection.description: Whether people can pick the map style. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

showDetailsCategory.displayName: Show category and subcategory on location details
showDetailsCategory.description: Whether a location's categories show on its page. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

showContributorName.description: Whether the name of the person who added a location shows on its page. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

detailsMapPosition.description: Where the map shows on a location's page. Leave it out to keep the current position.

introVisibility.description: Who sees the introduction screen; users with tags means the tags chosen in the control panel. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

introDescription.description: The text shown on the introduction screen. Leave it out to keep the current text, or leave it empty to remove it.

introImages.description: The carousel at the top of the introduction screen, in order, each item with its picture and what tapping it does. Replaces the current carousel; an empty list removes it. Leave it out to keep the current carousel.

introSorting.description: How the introduction screen sorts its locations. Leave it out to keep the current sorting.

introLocationSource.description: Which locations the introduction screen shows. Leave it out to keep the current source.

introAreaLatitude.description: The latitude of the local area's center, given with its longitude. Leave it out to keep the current center.

introAreaLongitude.description: The longitude of the local area's center, given with its latitude. Leave it out to keep the current center.

introAreaAddress.description: The address shown for the local area's center. Leave it out to keep the current one.

introAreaRadius.description: How far around the center the local area reaches, in miles. Leave it out to keep the current radius.

callback.description: Runs when the settings are saved.

error.description: Why nothing was saved, such as no setting being given or distance sorting while nearest first is off.

result.description: The settings as they are now.

hidePriceFilter.description: Whether the price choice is hidden when people narrow the list.

allowStyleSelection.description: Whether people can pick the map style.

showDetailsCategory.description: Whether categories show on a location.

showContributorName.description: Whether the contributor's name shows on a location.
